parameters.name: AgentKey
parameters.description: The business workspace key. If this parameter is not specified, the default business workspace is accessed. Obtain the key value from the business management page of the Alibaba Cloud account.

parameters.name: Avatar
parameters.description: The URL of the chatbot avatar. The URL must be publicly accessible, such as an OSS resource URL. The URL can be up to 1024 characters in length.

parameters.name: Introduction
parameters.description: The description of the chatbot. The description can be up to 50 characters in length.

parameters.name: LanguageCode
parameters.description: The language of the chatbot service, such as zh-cn or en-us.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the chatbot. The name can be up to 50 characters in length.

parameters.name: RobotType
parameters.description: The type of the chatbot. Default value: scenario_im.
